selection.method: Derive a fully charged favorable relaxation for sharing one centre path across k calls, including restoration, hosting and precision.

method: Extract the pinned backward eight-center event grammar and coefficients, emit separate and aggregated two-panel words, verify exact arbitrary-input restoration and all charged events, and prove a positive-coefficient envelope bound using a common literal linear child prefix. Evaluate the fused invoice at payload precision mu+1 rather than mu.

contract.sinks: The same eight persistent center source values S at the post-A cut; these are computed values after A, not the original 112 source inputs X.
contract.rows: Two disjoint read-only panel banks; S and the eight scratch rows are distinct from the panels and from one another. Baseline and fused words share the same eight scratch rows.
contract.scratch: Scratch inputs are arbitrary. Both separate and fused words clear them before reading their contents and return all eight scratch rows to zero; no extra private row silently disappears.
contract.native_calls: For each center, both panels use the same exact linear return operator B_k=F_k^-1=F_k^dagger, with identical frame/chart/coordinate convention and complete child scratch/head-return contract.
contract.chronology: No intervening mutation of either panel or the shared sinks, and no intermediate observer. The two panels and shared sinks remain exclusively reserved for the local batch.
contract.endpoint: Read-only panels unchanged; each S_j receives the sum of the two specified backward center returns; all scratch rows zero.

precision_guard.statement: For nonnegative incoming-register budgets, the fused positive-coefficient envelope is at most twice the maximum separate-panel envelope. For each exact linear child prefix P_t(u,w)=K_t u+L_t w, the same bound includes a common worst-case envelope for unchanged private dirt w. One additional magnitude bit suffices for this local envelope comparison; actual child prefixes remain uninstantiated.
precision_guard.scope: Local magnitude headroom only. This is not a rounded native precision theorem, complete denominator/tape bound, full-call prefix bound or hosting admission.
precision_guard.weighted_bill: With complete rank-eight child price c8(mu), ADD price a(mu), CLEAR price e(mu), and total extra admission/restoration/routing/precision/hosting overhead DeltaH>=0, compare 16*c8(mu)+368*a(mu)+32*e(mu) against 8*c8(mu+1)+360*a(mu+1)+16*e(mu+1)+DeltaH. Prices must include actual work at the prescribed frame/ports.
precision_guard.linear_example: If every event has unit linear tariff c8(mu)=a(mu)=e(mu)=mu, the separate-minus-fused difference is 32*mu-384-DeltaH. With DeltaH=0, mu=12 ties and mu=13 saves 32. This is an example tariff, not an admitted native-child cost.
precision_guard.moment_limit: The rank-eight child count halves only within this local two-panel contract. Changed payload width, volume, eligible calls and hosting must be included in any replacement recurrence; the incumbent ceiling cannot establish a global gain.
